items.summary: CRO recommends retaining three evidence-backed opportunities for later isolated validation: a reusable affiliate/CTA component system, offline source-to-Markdown content normalization, and static explanatory diagrams. Current containment remains appropriate because measurement, attribution, failure repair, ownership, security, and release gates are incomplete. No deployment, dependency installation, spend, telemetry change, or owner approval request is made.

Repository signals support feasibility research, not adoption. Before any implementation, require an isolated fixture-only prototype, license review, dependency and supply-chain review, deterministic tests, rollback evidence, and a measurable acceptance metric. Preserve all three opportunities as deferred research backlog until existing containment gates clear.
